metadata.title: On Quadrature Surface Free Boundary Problems for the Riemannian $p$-Laplacian
metadata.abstract: We study a quadrature-surface free boundary problem driven by the Riemannian $p$-Laplacian on a smooth compact finite-dimensional Riemannian manifold. We formulate the problem as a shape optimization problem and develop an intrinsic admissible class based on a uniform Riemannian $RC$-$GNP$ condition~\cite{DS3}. We establish compactness of admissible domains and stability of the associated Dirichlet problems under strong $RC$-$GNP$ convergence. In particular, the states converge strongly in $W^{1,p}$ and the associated $p$-torsional energy is continuous. Under additional boundary regularity, we derive the first variation of the shape functional and obtain the free-boundary Euler--Lagrange condition \[ |\nabla_g u_\Omega|_g^p=\sigma H_{\partial\Omega}+k^p. \] We also formulate the contact optimality inequality, prove the Riemannian comparison of second fundamental forms at tangential contact, and obtain a sufficient condition on a reference domain which rules out contact and yields a solution of the free-boundary problem. Explicit radial examples on geodesic balls of the round sphere are included.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 将紧 Riemannian 流形上的 p-Laplacian 求积曲面自由边界问题写成形状优化问题，证明可容许域紧致性与状态稳定性，并导出边界最优条件。
analysis.breakthrough: 用排除接触的参考域充分条件，将变分最优性提升为自由边界问题的解。
analysis.limitations: 一阶变分需要额外边界正则性；存在性依赖可容许类与排除接触条件，不是任意域的结果。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
